title: North American beaver population (millions)

source.name: Beaver population history and management
source.publisher: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS)

notes: Pre-colonial North American beaver population is widely cited in ecological literature as 60-400 million, with substantial uncertainty since it is extrapolated from a handful of regional studies; 100 million is used here as a commonly-cited representative figure for the low end of that range. The fur-trade crash to roughly 100,000 individuals by the early 1900s is well documented. Current population estimates commonly range 10-15 million after decades of trapping limits and reintroduction; 12 million is used as the midpoint.
